reviews.text: I've been coming to Westside Veterinary since 1985 or 1986. I've never had any complaints. The staff and the doctors are excellent. In almost 40 years and two cats and three dogs later, I would recommend this facility to anyone who has a pet...💯

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Westside Veterinary Center! When my Georgie became sick, Jordan, Dr. Chang, and Dr. Nappolitano were incredibly caring, knowledgeable, and reassuring every step of the way. They treated Georgie like she was their own and gave me so much peace of mind. She’s my baby, and I’m so grateful to have such an amazing team in her corner. Also shout out to Jordan, Cyn and Tammy, at the front desk, for all of their support and help.

We had a new patient appointment for our English bulldog rescue with Dr. Smith and Anissa and they were absolutely fantastic! Thorough, knowledgeable, and patient: they made us and our pup feel comfortable and at home. I am confident we are receiving excellent care and we plan to continue treating with them!

I have been going to the Westside Veterinary Center for about 30 years - ever since I got my first cats. While there has been some changeover in the people there - both doctors and staff - they have all been VERY good.
One of the initial doctors, Dr. Cantor, is still there several days a week - she has been my main "go-to" vet since the beginning. Dr. Lewis has been excellent; all the technicians and nurses have been awesome and caring.
All of them listen and want to hear what you've noticed about your pet's behavior that's been different from usual. They do not jump to conclusions - they test and take steps to clarify a diagnosis.
They really do care a lot about animals - and their interactions with our cats have been reassuring both to us and the cats - they know they are in good hands.
While it is not cheap, they are not looking for ways to jack up the costs...they do work to do one thing/test at a time and they see how effective it has been before doing something else.
I love my cats - and trust them to do all that they can to help them live healthy long lives.

Fully recommend Dr Chang and the Westside Veterinary team.

It’s hard to find a vet that feels local in NYC (especially with so many chains popping up), but Westside is an exception. They really do care about their patients.

Dr Chang is incredibly knowledgeable, she always takes the time to explain/answer questions (even when you have many)!

Dr Chang and Westside also helped our family navigate the hardest part of pet ownership- emergency hospitalization and eventually end of life care. The team was gentle throughout, it was clear they genuinely cared about our cat and helping us make the best decisions possible. It made a really horrible moment slightly better, which we will always appreciate.

I called Westside Vet Center when my dog was in a lot of pain because of a hotspot on his neck. The nurse said I could bring him in asap and they’d fit me in. When I arrived the staff was so friendly and helpful. The doctor’s assistant couldn’t have been nicer. Dr Chang cared for Lucky (we hardly had to wait). He was very “squirrelly”and jumpy due to the pain but Dr Chang was so good with him, got his wound cleaned, gave him an antibiotic injection (he resists pills), and prescribed a few Rx’s. she called to check on him the next day and answered all my questions. Lucky’s doing much better now thanks to Dr Chang and the caring staff at Westside Vet.
The best vet in the UWS! Brought our little kitty who came from foster care here for a check up. Great service from receptionists, techs & doctors. Can’t recommend enough!
Called 3 times only to be put on hold and then hung up on.

This practice is a little far for me, but I’ve had such a good experience it’s worth it. My Frenchie needed a teeth cleaning and extractions and they made the process smooth, transparent, and friendly. The staff is always very helpful, the space is spotless, and the vets are kind, knowledgeable, engaged and committed. I always have 100% peace of mind when I bring or drop off my frenchie here. It’s easy to get ahold of the practice via phone or email which was not always the case with other practices I visited. I feel a sense of peace and trust when dealing with Westside Vet that I have not experienced with the chain practices you see popping up all over.

Every vet I've seen at Westside has been fantastic. They're confident, direct, and can handle my 65-pound anxious, terrified dog without making me apologize. Prices seem reasonable and they don't try to upsell you on anything. Highly recommend this place.
my vets for over 35 years and couldn't be happier. both dogs and cats and counting

When I arrived at Westside Veterinary Center, everyone was polite and professional. I was treated like a valued client, but more importantly, my dogs, my babies, were treated with great care and kindness. They were valued patients. Our veterinarian is great. Lots of patience with me, and very good with my dogs.
Terrific care!

I am so grateful for the way Dr. Chang and Caitlyn were able to examine my very stressed-out 20 year-old cat. She has always had a tough time with vets, and Dr. Chang and Caitlyn handled her like pros.

My husband and I recently moved back to the UWS. On Thursday, our cat wouldn't stop walking in a circle. Even though she wasn't a patient at Westside, WVC agreed to see her immediately.

Dr. Chang was so knowledgable and did a thorough examination. She explained everything clearly and put me at ease. My cat is doing much better now. I hope Dr. Chang will be at WVC for a while, because she is the only one I want treating my little lion from now on.

While I was waiting for my cat's test results, I observed the front-desk staff for about a half hour. They were so kind to every person who entered. They made a big fuss over all of the animals. You could feel the love in the room.

Not only will my cat be a Westside patient from now on, but I will highly recommentd WVC to anyone who asks. Thank you again!
The staff is very friendly and efficient.

I've been bringing my dogs here for years and have always received excellent care. Dr. Bodkin is the best—even my very shy, anxious Chihuahua immediately warmed up to her and now doesn't mind going to the vet at all. I feel lucky to have this practice in the neighborhood and am grateful for the care they've taken of my dogs over the years.

I read the reviews of many places and chose this place for their stellar reviews and am glad I did.  The location is easily accessible, the staff is all so friendly and helpful, and my dog got the care he needed very quickly.  This will be our new go to for my puppy.

I was looking for a new vet.
We found Westside. It was easy to get an appointment. We brought in my cat. We were received with lots of attention and smiles.
Lots of questions were asked. We were told we would see Dr. Lewis. She was courteous, attentive, and informative.
We will return.

These are the most wonderful people. All the way from front desk staff to the vets. I’ve been going to this vet for several years now. It was recommended to me by my MD neighbors. I thought vet recommendation from MDs carries different weight. Sure enough, Doctor Bodkin has been very thorough and serious about taking care of my pup. When she says she’ll call me with updates, she calls when she said she was calling. She has so much experience that I trust her care completely. Highly recommend this vet.

Very grateful to have found this practice! Dr. McArthur is the best vet my dog has ever had, she makes him feel calm and safe. Billing has also been fair and transparent, they were also quick at communicating with my pet insurance when I filed a claim.

I moved to NYC last year. I have an older cat with serious existing health issues. My vet in California recommended Westside specifically.

The vet I saw examined my cat, reviewed her history, and pinpointed her weight loss  as the most critical issue. She then made a  plan tailored to my cat.

Several months later, my cat is doing better than she has for maybe a year. She is up to an appropriate weight. She is keeping her food down. And she generally seems to be doing well around the apartment.

I’m so appreciative of my vet and the staff at Westside for taking great care of us.

Highly recommended.

From the initial phone call to arriving and meeting the doctor for her new patient wellness exam, everyone was so kind. Luna a.k.a. Boo-boo is 18 so she had blood tests and they did her nails 💖It truly was like visiting our new best friends. Thank you for making a Vet visit so easy for my sweet girl. …

I was a new client after leaving my former vet which was taken over by private equity and started raising prices after a lot of staff departures.

My cat was in late stage kidney failure and we took the pragmatic approach for a 14 year old and continued to manage it until we couldn't any longer.

I made the decision to end her suffering as she had stopped responding to treatment and stopped eating as well.

The staff handled my decision with compassion and professionalism.  When it was time to come in when it was clear she could no longer walk or stand or barely manage to purr, I and my little one were handled as best as I could hope for, as difficult as it was.

I will be back when I'm ready for my next round of rescues to care for.

Thank you again for all your kind work.

I used Westside Veterinary since 1991 for 3 cats . During the 90’s if you had an issue with your cat , you were told to bring the cat  right over and you would be seen. It did not matter that you did not have an appointment there was always someone available to see your cat
I had previously seen Dr Smith in Nov 2025 who gave me pre  ultrasound medication and told me to call if my cat continued to  vomit  to get an ultrasound
My cat had not vomited foe several months. But recently stated to vomit  on May  30. As per Dr smitb instructions   I  called and was happy to find out the  radiologist who did ultrasounds was  available . .  I was told at 8am  on Tuesday  June 2 my cat would be scheduled for an ultrasound  on Wednesday June 3 and  to call back at noon on June 2  to find out what time to bring my cat in . I had the  medication. And instructions given to me by Dr Smitb . From November
I called back after 12 noon and was told to bring my cat  in by 7:0 -8am. On June 2 Around 1:30 I   received a call  that the ultrasound had to be Oked by Dr Smith. But she was not in and  not available till after 3 pm . Dr Smith previously  told me and gave me pre medication  regarding the ultra sound   For. Vomit issues  which I told the front desk
I was told around 3:30 that my  cat could not undergo an  ultrasound  because it had been  a couple of months since  my cat had been seen at Westside Vet
I explained I had been inPA because  my mom was in hospice  and. Recently passed  and I had just returned to the city .  I had a cat sitter who reported the vomiting . Apparently
My cat just  had started  vomiting in May   after not vomiting  since November
the recommendation was by Dr Smith  was to get an ultra sound as per her November instructions.
I was told at 3pm my cat had to be be seen   Prior to the ultra sound. By a Vet I was not happy to take my cat the night before to be seen however I agreed so my cat could undergo the ultra  sound. In a timely. Fashion on Wednesday June 3
A women  at the front desk told me she  would. Try and ask DrSmitb If she could squeeze me  in . I waited for the callback which I never I never received . I finally called back around 4 pm and was told NeitherDr Smith or any else could see  my cat despite the fact they are  open till 9pm
I was rudely told by the male at the front desk there are other places that do ultrasounds. He gave me 2 Dr. names and I asked for the phone numbers. He said do not have the numbers and acted annoyed that I asked
I goggled the  names could not find any listing .  I called back and he hung up  on me .
At that point
I decided to transfer my care to another  vet.  Practice  and got an immediate appointment and helpful advice. Even though  my cat was not yet a patient
I feel really badly that the care at Westside vet has deteriorated m.    It used to be a wonderful place.

I

We brought our dog here and she was completely misdiagnosed after overcharging us for tests. We are confident the medication prescribed based on that wrong diagnosis contributed to her dying just a few days later.

I cannot recommend this clinic to anyone looking for safe, empathetic care for their pet.

This time I came with my husband for our dog’s check up and vaccine. We were so moved by how well behaved all the animals were. You could tell they knew they were in a safe place.
Our appointment with Dr. Rosenthal was great, we learned things to help us get weight off our always hungry dog and left feeling he was in good health.

Not happy with the service and front desk attitude. We paid about $50 less than a month ago to have our dog’s gland drained. The service is not very good, so our dog started having the symptoms again in such a short period. I called the front desk and explained the situation, he first asked me to come in to pay for a doctor visit. I told him that we don’t need a doctor visit and this nurse visit should be offered without charge because the last one was not done professionally. After a couple of minutes consulting with his colleagues, he told me to wait until two days later for the management to call me back to see if they can offer this commentary nurse visit.  I asked if they can do this faster by emails or calls, he said nope, man, you have to wait until Tuesday (it is Sunday). Simply don’t care. :(

I’ve been to many vets in upper Manhattan, and Westside Veterinary Center is hands down THE BEST. The vets are incredibly caring and thorough- they have gone above and beyond for my three cats.
Dr. Jones, in particular, is the best family doctor I’ve ever had for my animals— she is incredibly caring, responsive, and supportive. She is a holistic thought-partner and practioner who has shifted my relationship to animal care— thanks to Dr. Jones, I feel confident in a doctor who knows my animals intimately and will take a well-rounded approach to ensure my babies live long healthy lives. Dr. Jones always goes the extra mile to explore solutions, actively keeps in touch via email as needed, and always makes time for my babies in the event of an emergency.
If you live further away from this practice, the commute is worth it! I wouldn’t go anywhere else in NYC.

An amazing experience. Dr. Cantor was so kind, thoughtful and caring to my guinea pigs (and me).
And the staff was terrific too!

I'm so grateful to everyone at Westside Veterinary Center for taking such amazing care of my gerbil, Brunson (yes, named after the New York Knicks player)! He had a mass on his scent gland, and I was really nervous about surgery because he’s an older gerbil. Dr. Cantor was incredibly kind and reassuring — she took the time to explain everything, went over the risks honestly, and helped me feel comfortable making an informed decision about whether to move forward with the surgery. Dr. Kosovsky did Brunson’s surgery, and it went so well. He is now acting like himself again — even more lively and playful than before, and definitely much more comfortable without the mass on his belly. Everyone at the clinic was so friendly and caring throughout the whole process, and they even squeezed us in for an emergency visit when Brunson started acting poorly from the mass. You can really tell how much the staff cares about the animals they treat. Thank you so much to the entire team for helping my little guy feel better again. He’s healing beautifully and is happy as can be. I highly recommend Westside Veterinary Center, especially if you have small pets!

Unfortunately I had to adjust my review down to 1 star. The people here are friendly but after coming here a few times it’s obvious that they’re charging way too much for the service they provide.

The appointments are short and they don’t actually take the time / effort to really check out your pet. I started going to a different vet recently and they pointed out a few potential issues right away with my cat that were never brought up or discussed at Westside. When I had brought up some related concerns with my kitten earlier at Westside with Dr. Lewis, they were quickly dismissed / waved away.

Finally, the prices are outrageous for the level of service you get. Almost price gouging levels. I was quoted 3k (crazy right?) for a standard cryptorchid kitten neuter including bloodwork. Even for nyc that is unheard of. Ended up doing the neuter at a different vet a few blocks away for $500.

They also charge you crazy prices at every step of the way for standard care as well. Don’t come here, even if you can afford it the value’s just not there.
During the emergency none other veterinary was able to help us with Aaron, but with just one call here Dr. Chang and Dr. Friedman made a difference! Thank you! Front desk is also very polite
Great place to bring your best friends!!!
Caring, efficient, knowledgeable, excellent. Thanks Westside Vet.

wonderful caring clinic.  all staff are professional and obviously love animals.  the doctors are knowledgeable and terrific with your pet.  Most important Phineas  { my cat.} isn’t nervous when handled by the staff. Kudos to WVC.

Dr. Napolitano and the entire team have meant so much to me during one of the hardest times of my life. The care, compassion, and kindness they have shown Milo has been something I will never forget. You can tell Dr. Napolitano truly cares, not just as a veterinarian, but as a person. In moments that felt scary and heartbreaking, I felt supported, heard, and like Milo was genuinely in loving hands. I am beyond grateful for everything they have done for him and for me. Thank you, Dr. Napolitano, for treating Milo with such tenderness and for giving me comfort through all of this.

I have been bringing dogs here for over 10 years. The staff is caring and sympathetic. Dr. Napolitano is a wonderful vet with excellent skills. I have also had dogs seen by Dr. Lewis who is also very caring and competent. I highly recommend the Center.

I am grateful for the stellar care for my female dog companion from the veterinarian and the technicians and staff at Westside Veterinary Center.  I felt that the care reflected deep expertise and experience.

I am impressed by the smooth process at the office - In spite of the busy environment, I felt fully attended to and our needs were met.  I was able to get a first-time appointment within a short timeframe, and it was a streamlined process to set up.

Follow-up communication from the doctor and staff is excellent.  Time is given to hear and clearly and fully answer questions.

I highly recommend this veterinary practice.

Edit: I just wanted to edit my review to add that my dog recently passed away, and on his last day, Dr. Emily Chang treated him with such care and love. When she heard the news from a vet tech later in the evening after we came home from the vet, she called me back to talk to me. Everyone I encountered that day was so kind. This vet practice and their entire staff are a neighborhood gem.

We’ve been coming here for a decade now for both my dog and cat and have always had a great experience with Dr. Rutherford. Someone in the neighborhood recommended her when I lived here and we have seen her ever since. She is always so gentle with our pets; our cat is never scared. Our appointments never feel rushed and she always takes the time to answer any questions and explain things thoroughly.

The front desk staff and everyone who picks up the phone are always polite and helpful. It’s very easy to schedule here.

I have occasionally used another vet in a different neighborhood, and it has been nowhere near as good of an experience.

I take my French bulldog, Winston, here every 4-5 weeks for acupuncture for his IVDD with either Dr. Jones or Dr. Lewis and I’ve always had an excellent experience. Clinic staff have always been so kind and polite and are very responsive over e-mail
The absolute best. End of review.
Amazing vet and care. Doctor Cantor really listens to your concerns and treats you dog with a lot of love and respect.

Best vet office in the area - staff are wonderful and Dr. Rutherford is so smart and kind. Just editing my review to add that the front desk staff are true angels and every vet I've seen has been so lovely. Truly the greatest group of people.
Great service! I am very pleased with the service and care provided to my two dogs!

Westside Vet Center is amazing. Dr. Friedman is very down-to-earth and takes great care of my puppy. The staff seem to love working there and are very considerate and helpful. I’ve never had a problem getting in contact with them or making an appointment. I appreciate them a lot.

I just brought my 16 year old cat for a check up. My cat wasn’t so excited about the visit, but my experience couldn’t have been better. The staff - everyone from the front desk to the vet assistant to the doctor - are animal lovers and truly kind and welcoming. A great veterinary practice. Highly recommend them.

Dr Kim Rosenthal saved our sweet dog's life and continues to monitor his complicated health.  She is the smartest, thoughtful and compassionate person and always goes way beyond our expectations.  She is attentive to every detail, remembering all of his medical issues and his quirks.  We thank our lucky stars every day (not kidding) that a mutual friend put us in touch after the specialists at Blue Pearl told us to put our dog down.  Dr Rosenthal nursed him back to health, little by little, with thoughtful tweaks with medication.  She doesn't give up and at the same time she is very aware of the quality of life of her patients, which we really appreciate.  We love her!

Also the staff are fantastic, always trying to make our experience less stressful.  They are professional, warm and caring.
We have been going to Westside Vet for more than 15 years. The staff is amazing and we just adore Dr. Napolitano. We so appreciate their expert care, advice and kindness.

I've been a client at Westside Veterinary Center for almost 30 years. The doctors, vet techs and staff are all top-notch. I moved out of the neighborhood 7 years ago, but I still go there. I don't trust anyone else with my furry best friend. Special shout out to Dr. Bodkin who has been there since the beginning. She is kind, practical and compassionate. She takes care of me just as much as my cat, as I tend to be a very worried pet parent. I love Westside Vet!

We've lived in the area for ten years and have brought our two cats there when needed.   We've had wonderful experiences with both Dr. Rutherford and Dr. Smith and many of the assistants, especially Shanice.  The front desk can get a bit hectic but the care and attention our pets get is wonderful.  We are very happy with their devotion to our loved ones.
Great customer service and great team.   Really will give you pets the best care.

Westside Veterinary is the BEST. The staff is wonderful. Dr. Friedman took very good care of my cat. She was very knowledgeable of the issues Sterling was having and was able to resolve them. I loved how she took time to call and check in on Sterling's progress days after his procedure. In addition, Dr. Chang was great as well. She was very attentive and gave me a detailed report of Sterling's catheter removal process. Going forward WSV is definitely my choice for all of Sterling's medical needs. Thanks to Dr. Friedman, Dr. Chang and the entire Westside Veterinary Center staff from Sterling and myself!
Dr Kim Rosenthal is the finest veterinary doctor we have ever had. Been with her for nearly 40 years. She doesn't BS , goes right to the cause... best diagnostician you can find.

I had a great experience at Westside Vet - it was my first time taking my dog to get a bump on her head checked out. Dr. McArthur was very thorough, friendly, and was able to get the removal + biopsy done quickly. I had previously used small door, which had wanted to charge us for general anesthesia for the procedure, which was risky and unnecessary. It feels like Westside has more of our best interests in mind, would highly recommend them for your pet.

I moved away from the UWS and tried a vet in Chelsea. It reminded me how amazing this place is. 1. They are so excited to see your pet and will remember them 2. The wait is never longer than 5-10 minutes 3. The prices are far more reasonable than the vet I just went to elsewhere. It was 3x more.

Highly recommend Westside vet center, I will be bringing my cat up to here rather than going local next time - it is worth it.

I had a great first experience at Westside Vet! Everyone was so friendly, and they really took the time to listen and help with the problem at hand. I had been planning to establish care here but had to come on a somewhat urgent basis for the first visit and they made everything very easy and comfortable - I feel great about establishing my dogs care here.

I can’t say enough good things about this Westside Veterinary. Over the years I have had personal experiences at other vets in nyc of being upcharged during the most vulnerable moments in which my beloved dog was in need of treatment and felt taken advantage of by costly unnecessary tests. The team here is incredibly honest, compassionate, and skilled. They always focus on what’s truly necessary to diagnose and treat my Old English bulldog Lulu, never trying to upsell or push unnecessary tests or procedures. It’s so refreshing to have a vet I can completely trust. They explain everything clearly, take the time to answer all my questions, and genuinely care about both the animals and the people who love them. I wouldn’t take my dog anywhere else! Highly recommend to anyone looking for a vet who puts integrity and quality care first.

I have used the services of West Side Veterinary Center for more than 20 years. They have always taken wonderful, compassionate care of my cats. You can see in the waiting room that even the nervous patients are still happy to see the staff, which says a lot. I am grateful to have this hospital nearby!

We were overcharged and said we should be grateful for it. We came in midday on a weekday with our cat because he was having urinary issues, they recommended surgery and said they would keep him until the surgery because he was blocked. We were given a quote that we agreed to. The next day Dr.Lewis called us saying there might be an emergency surgery charge of 200-500$ that is usually waived; we assumed it would be because it was not an emergency. When we went to pick up our cat the charge was 800$. We queried the charge and Dr Rosenthal came and spoke to us. She berated us in the waiting room saying we should just be happy that they saved our cat and it would be more expensive elsewhere. She was very disrespectful, argumentative and condescending, interrupting me several times. Eventually Dr.Lewis got in touch, apologised and refunded us 300$ but I can't get over how poorly Dr. Rosenthal spoke to us; I wouldn't use this vet again and don't trust their charging practices.

Thank you so much for your  kindness, support, and hugs during this time of tremendous loss. Blanket will truly be missed. Thank you for making this time of loss a little bit easier. Love Always
Ruby
This vet is wonderful, compassionate and understanding. I am so happy I went back to them.

I've been taking my very own pinky and the brain (i.e. dog and cat, respectively) here for a few years now to see Dr. Rosenthal and I have only good things to say. Not only is Dr. Rosenthal incredibly knowledgeable, she quite clearly cares for each and every animal as if it's her own. On more than one occasion, she has bent over backwards to fit my animals in for an appointment and seems unfazed by my kitty's quest for world domination.

I also want to say that the staff is incredible. They're friendly and go above and beyond to make sure the animals (and humans) have as stress-free of an experience as possible.
My dog recently had an appointment with Dr. Friedman who was excellent! She is patient, thoughtfully considered all my questions, and gave great care to my dog. Best Vet on the UWS!

Westside Veterinary Center provides superlative care for any pet.  The office staff is efficient and caring and the Vet Techs are very professional and knowledgeable.  A special shout-out to Dr. Botkin and to Vet Tech Anton for the outstanding care they have given to our two cats on outpatient and inpatient- boarding circumstances.

Went there for an annual checkup at the suggestion of some dog owners in the neighborhood. Will be returning to my old vet in our old neighborhood next year.  Very expensive and not worth the markup IMO. The checkup was very fast, did not feel thorough. Vet offered no suggestions to any issues I brought up. Said I needed a teeth cleaning and sent me a quote of $1980, after much searching I found another provider for half the price. Other people had told me they got their teeth cleaned at the same place for less money so it feels like they either raise the prices constantly or just tack on fees to see if you'll pay.  It's very hard BTW because each provider wants to bring your dog in for a checkup first before giving a dental estimate so it almost feels like they're using that over you to charge so much more than they should. The 10 minute checkup was $170 and they marked my dogs records as having done bloodwork and a stool sample though none was offered (this is offered annually at my old vet). Did not offer me a prescription refill either or let me know about the newer medications available for tick/heartworm.

The pros was the the appointment was very easy to make thanks to their online system.

We started using this vet because they can handle the paperwork for international travel for pets. However, the doctors are both skilled and sympathetic, and the staff is efficient and caring, so we have stayed with them even though it's a bit of a schlep from our home.

I have been taking my fur baby to Westside for over 3 to 4 years now and I am so pleased with their services.  I love this place.  Dr Karen Canton is so helpful, thoughtful and kind.  My baby actually looks forward to his visits.

I have been bringing my dog Max here f or over 11years and have always been impressed by the high quality of care provided by all the staff. From the time you come in ..the receptionists are so nice and helpful, the aides and nurses so caring and professional. And the doctors Great!  Max does have his primary Vet who is terrific, Dr.Cantor.  But one of the many great strengths is that all the doctors that Max has seen have been excellent! That is so comforting to know that whoever sees him will take good care of him.  I find the costs to be quite fair I have never been overcharged. Everything and procedure has been explained and no unnecessary procedures done.  Best of all it is a 24/7operation. When Max got sick at 2am I called, took him in and he was seen helped and lovingly cared for. What an amazing place!

I've been using WestSide Veterinary Center for 3 generations of dogs and have always found them to be fully committed to the well-being of animals under their care.   They clearly identify and discuss the options for care in all cases.   I have complete trust in them.
Updating my review.  I have been going here for years and they are the best.  My cat sees Dr Lewis but in the past I brought my pet in on an emergency and they were great!  HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!
The problems I had with my dogs were cleared up in a matter of two days  They are spot on!

Always accommodating when making an appointment. Very caring environment and always happy when we leave! Thank you everyone! From the front desk to the doctors( Kantor and Rutherford) my dog always receives top notch care.
Very professional and caring vets and staff. Highly recommend.

We recently switched to Westside Veterinary Center and are very pleased with our choice. Dr. Emily Chang is absolutely wonderful with our two dogs. She also accurately and quickly diagnosed a health condition which our previous vet clinic had been unable to diagnose for nearly two years (and which sadly resulted in needless suffering for our dog and thousands of dollars in fruitless expenses for us). Thanks to Dr. Chang and the team at Westside, we have our dog back. He is active, alert, and his engaging personality has re-emerged. We're extremely grateful. I'd also like to mention and thank the caring, well-organized and friendly front desk staff and technicians/assistants. We also appreciate the array of services available at Westside, including care for exotic pets, boarding, emergency services, etc. We highly recommend them!
Dr. Rutherford is the absolute best. The staff is amazing and I know they take the best care of my fur baby

While out of town my dog started to have a limp in his walk. I immediately contacted my vet at WSV and after arriving home on a Wednesday they saw me the very next day and performed the necessary surgery to repair Max’s torn ACL. He’s now recovering and am assured he should be fine. This is a level of care that keeps me a very happy dog dad and client of WSV. Thanks to all for your help.

I am so thankful for Westside Veterinary Center.  Very few places care for parakeets and the one or two Avian places are ridiculously expensive and expected money upfront before I even brought my beautiful budgie "Cookie" in for her first wellness check when I rescued her after she was abandoned in an apartment for 6 days with hardly any food or water.  So grateful that Dr. Cantor was able to see her fairly quickly and didn't charge me a fortune to do so. She is very kind, caring and professional.  The facility is clean and is always "buzzing" with dogs, cats, etc. and their owners.  The staff is always kind and helpful on the phone and in person.  I've had Cookie for a little over two years and am still learning how to care for her because I always had dogs in my life.  Dr. Cantor has been extremely instrumental in helping me and somewhat educating me about caring for my parakeet. I can't imagine going anywhere else and getting the attention to detail and kindness that my sweet bird and I have received.
